display-mobile.purpose: Compact mobile introduction, retaining display weight and tracking.

display-compact.purpose: Size-only override at widths up to 380px.

body.purpose: Root body stack; no inferred browser-default size token.

artifact-control.purpose: Fan out or stack up the authored collection sleeves; quality preferences live separately in Settings.

personal-page.purpose: 52px desktop, 41px mobile, 37px narrow; retain Barlow voice but omit redundant mobile tagline.

ratings-data.purpose: 13-14px Hanken with tabular numerals, 11-12px native-scale labels; no independent-review implication for source rank index.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Existing named easing token, not permission for continuous decorative motion.

motion.name: control-state-transition
motion.purpose: Implemented button and link state transitions.

narrative.overview:
Warm chalk, graphite ink and flat acid-lime sleeves make a finite collection feel like a handled record-store crate. Condensed box-art typography, numbered jackets and open ruled lists carry the identity; controls remain direct and unornamented.

The implemented collection is an Operate surface: finding, filtering and opening a game takes priority over spectacle. Ordinary scrolling and optional dimensional motion keep the catalogue usable without completing an introduction. This describes the existing collection, not a mode requirement for every future surface.
keyCharacteristics: Chalk-and-ink clarity with flat lime emphasis.
Canonical rank numbers and authored jacket imagery.
Compact controls, responsive density and optional motion.

rules.name: The Rank Rule
rules.body: Keep canonical rank visible; sorting changes presentation, never the displayed authored rank.

dos: Do preserve canonical rank and recognizable supplied artwork.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and interactive targets at least 44px.
Do retain the compact mobile introduction and Explore all 100 CTA.
Do keep essential controls usable in Auto, Full and Lite.
donts: Don't use neon, glow, generic floating cards or decorative clutter.
Don't enlarge tiny cover files or substitute invented artwork.
Don't run animation loops offscreen or against system reduced-motion preferences.
Don't present private device state as a change to the public collection.
Don't put the decorative introduction ahead of table mode.
Don't promise private IndexedDB data is cloud-synced or safe from manual browser-data deletion.
Don't introduce external artwork or invented critic scores for imported catalog records.
